name: WTS
recent: WTS Capital Berhad（前称Systech Bhd）于2026年9月完成更名，并在特别股东大会上通过削减最多RM4000万已发行股本的议案。公司2026财年第二季净利按年增长18.8%，营收接近三倍增长。近期多名董事及大股东在闭门期内外申报买卖公司股份。
notable: 公司于2026年9月11日举行特别股东大会，通过削减最多RM4000万已发行股本的特别决议，以及将公司名称由Systech Bhd更改为WTS Capital Berhad的特别决议。
公司名称已由Systech Bhd正式更改为WTS Capital Berhad。
2026财年第二季净利按年增长18.8%，营收接近三倍增长。
risks: 执行董事Datuk Wira Lim Ying Ran在闭门期内于2026年11月5日及6日分别增持5,580,000股及2,120,000股。
董事经理Dr Low Min Yew于2026年10月16日及9月17日在闭门期外分别增持330,000股及10,000股。
大股东Gan Thiam Seng于2026年9月至11月期间多次申报股权变动。

recent_en: WTS Capital Berhad (formerly Systech Bhd) completed its name change in September 2026 and passed a special resolution to reduce issued share capital by up to RM40 million at an EGM. The company's 2Q FY2026 net profit rose 18.8% year-on-year, with revenue nearly tripling. Several directors and substantial shareholders recently reported share dealings both within and outside the closed period.
notable_en: The company held an EGM on 11 September 2026, approving a special resolution to reduce issued share capital by up to RM40 million and a special resolution to change its name from Systech Bhd to WTS Capital Berhad.
The company's name has been officially changed from Systech Bhd to WTS Capital Berhad.
2Q FY2026 net profit rose 18.8% year-on-year, with revenue nearly tripling.
risks_en: Executive Director Datuk Wira Lim Ying Ran acquired 5,580,000 shares and 2,120,000 shares on 5 and 6 November 2026 respectively during the closed period.
Managing Director Dr Low Min Yew acquired 330,000 shares and 10,000 shares outside the closed period on 16 October and 17 September 2026 respectively.
Substantial shareholder Gan Thiam Seng reported multiple changes in shareholding between September and November 2026.
earnings_en: 2Q FY2026 (ended 30 June 2026) revenue was RM152,036,000, up 906.3% year-on-year and down 44.6% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was RM1,451,000 with a net margin of 1.0%, turning positive from -0.6% in the prior period.
